name: CodeBlock
description: Displays code with syntax highlighting, copying, and optional line numbers, diffs or folding.

dependencies.name: shiki
dependencies.reason: Optional — provides syntax highlighting; without it code renders unhighlighted.

title.description: A file name or label, shown in a header inside the block beside the copy action

size.description: Code type step: md is mono 12 for documents and replies, sm is mono 11 for dense panels

showCopy.description: Show the copy action. It stays visible and says Copied or Couldn't copy for two seconds

startLineNumber.description: Starting line number (useful for code excerpts)

addedLines.description: Lines marked as added in diff view (e.g., [2, "4-6"])

removedLines.description: Lines marked as removed in diff view (e.g., [1, 3])

wordWrap.description: Enable word wrapping for long lines

defaultCollapsed.description: Initial collapsed state (only applies when collapsible is true)

collapsedLines.description: Number of lines to show when collapsed

onCopy.description: Callback fired when the copy button is clicked and copy succeeds

when: Code examples inside prose or docs
Showing what changed, as a diff
whenNot: The user needs to edit it (use an editor)
A couple of words inline (use a code element)
guidelines: Set language every time; wrong highlighting is worse than none
title names a real file or labels the snippet; it sits in the header with the copy action
size sm in dense panels and side columns; md everywhere else
Line numbers earn their keep once you need to point at a line
highlightLines for emphasis; addedLines and removedLines for diffs
maxHeight or collapsible keeps a long file from swallowing the page
CodeBlock.Tabbed groups the same snippet across languages
accessibility: Renders as semantic pre and code inside a focusable, named scroll region, so a keyboard can scroll long lines
The copy action is labelled Copy code and always visible; its result is announced in a status region and shown as words
The fold bar names what it shows (Show 5 more lines, Show less) and reports aria-expanded and aria-controls
Colours follow the theme; added and removed lines also carry a + or - marker

function App() {

examples.name: With Line Numbers
examples.description: Turn these on once a snippet is long enough to point at.
examples.code:
<CodeBlock code={`const greeting = "Hello";
const name = "World";
console.log(\`\${greeting}, \${name}!\`);`} language="typescript" showLineNumbers />

examples.name: Custom Start Line
examples.description: Numbering starts where the excerpt actually starts in the file.
examples.code:
<CodeBlock
  code={`  return (
    <button onClick={() => setCount(c => c + 1)}>
      Count: {count}
    </button>
  );
}`}
  language="tsx"
  showLineNumbers
  startLineNumber={15}
/>

examples.name: With Highlighted Lines
examples.description: Marks the lines the prose is talking about.
examples.code:
<CodeBlock code={`import { useState } from 'react';

function Counter() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);

  return (
    <button onClick={() => setCount(c => c + 1)}>
      Count: {count}
    </button>
  );
}`} language="tsx" showLineNumbers highlightLines={[4, '7-9']} />

examples.name: Diff View
examples.description: Added and removed lines, side by side with the rest.
examples.code:
<CodeBlock
  code={`import { useState } from 'react';
import { useCallback } from 'react';

function Counter() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const increment = () => setCount(c => c + 1);
  const increment = useCallback(() => setCount(c => c + 1), []);

  return <button onClick={increment}>Count: {count}</button>;
}`}
  language="tsx"
  showLineNumbers
  removedLines={[6]}
  addedLines={[2, 7]}
/>

examples.name: Word Wrap
examples.description: Long lines break instead of scrolling sideways.
examples.code:
<CodeBlock
  code={`const longString = "This is a very long string that would normally cause horizontal scrolling, but with word wrap enabled it will break to the next line instead.";`}
  language="typescript"
  wordWrap
/>

examples.name: Max Height with Scroll
examples.description: Caps the height so one snippet cannot own the page.
examples.code:
<CodeBlock
  code={`// This code block has a maximum height
function processItems(items: string[]) {
  const results = [];
  for (const item of items) {
    if (item.startsWith('_')) {
      continue;
    }
    const processed = item.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (processed.length > 0) {
      results.push(processed);
    }
  }
  return results;
}

export default processItems;`}
  language="typescript"
  maxHeight={150}
  showLineNumbers
/>

propsSummary: title: node - file name or label in the header beside copy
showCopy: boolean (default: true) - visible copy action with a Copied / Couldn't copy status
maxHeight: number - max height with scrolling

CodeBlock.Tabbed: tabs[] plus optional defaultTab/value/onValueChange for multi-language snippets; size/showCopy/showLineNumbers/wordWrap/maxHeight/collapsible/defaultCollapsed/collapsedLines forward to every panel
